summary: Iteration 182/183 backend testing complete. All 18 pytest tests pass. Bug fixes verified: invite email_sent=false when provider=none, bulk-invite per-row email status correct. New features verified: notification preferences API (GET/PUT /users/me/notification-prefs), partial patch, quiet hours, is_allowed() integration in news_push and chat_push services.

bug_fix_invite_email_sent.description: Invite email_sent flag is now only true when provider REAL sent it. With provider=none, returns email_sent=false, email_simulated=true
bug_fix_invite_email_sent.evidence: Test test_invite_with_provider_none_returns_email_sent_false passes - returns {email_sent: false, email_simulated: true, email_provider: 'simulated', email_status: 'logged'}

bug_fix_bulk_invite_per_row.description: Bulk-Invite returns email_sent per row correctly (not counting 'logged' as 'sent')
bug_fix_bulk_invite_per_row.evidence: Test test_bulk_invite_returns_per_row_email_status passes - summary.sent=0 with provider=none, each row has email_sent=false, simulated=true

feature_email_config_test_inline_smtp.description: POST /api/admin/email-config/test accepts body.smtp for unsaved config testing with masked-password-fallback

feature_notification_prefs_api.evidence: Tests test_get_default_notification_prefs, test_partial_patch_notification_prefs, test_update_quiet_hours all pass

feature_is_allowed_function.description: is_allowed(user_id, category, channel) blocks push when category disabled or quiet hours active; email ignores quiet hours; calls/urgent bypass prefs
feature_is_allowed_function.evidence: Direct function tests pass - unknown user/category/channel returns True (safe default), quiet hours only affect push

feature_news_push_skipped_prefs.description: news_push.dispatch_push_for_post has skipped_prefs counter; critical priority bypasses prefs
feature_news_push_skipped_prefs.evidence: Code review confirms is_allowed gate at line 118, skipped_prefs counter tracked and returned in stats

feature_chat_push_skipped_prefs.description: chat_push.push_new_chat_message has skipped_prefs counter; urgent/is_call bypasses prefs
feature_chat_push_skipped_prefs.evidence: Code review confirms is_allowed gate at line 119, skipped_prefs counter tracked, urgent/is_call bypass at line 118
